basic_details.job_title: MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online
basic_details.application_mode: Online only, through MECL Recruitment Portal (www.mecl.co.in, Career section)
basic_details.short_information: Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited (MECL), a Mini-Ratna-I Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, has invited online applications for 13 Executive Trainee posts in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines. This recruitment is conducted through the UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2024 score, for candidates who cleared the written round and appeared for the ESE 2024 interview but were not recommended for final selection by UPSC. Online registration opens on 1 August 2026 and closes on 14 August 2026, through the MECL Recruitment Portal

application_fee.details: An application registration fee of ₹500 is applicable for General/OBC/EWS candidates. The fee is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates. Payment must be made online through Net-Banking or a QR code hosted on the MECL website under the Careers section. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Visit the official MECL website: www.mecl.co.in and go to the "Career" section.
Register on the MECL Online Recruitment Portal with all mandatory details.
Log in and click on "Apply for a Post" to fill the online application form.
Enter personal details, educational qualification, UPSC ESE 2024 score, and category/community details accurately.
Upload the required scanned documents in the specified format and file size.
Pay the application fee (₹500 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable) online.
Submit the application before the closing date of 14 August 2026.
Take a printout of the system-generated application form for future reference.

Applications received through any mode other than the MECL Online Recruitment Portal will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to apply.

content_sections.heading: MECL Executive Trainee Vacancy 2026: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy break-up for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 is as follows: All 13 vacancies are for freshers. MECL has noted that these vacancies are provisional and may be increased, decreased, or not filled at the company's discretion.

content_sections.heading: MECL Executive Trainee Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 must meet the educational qualification and age limit given below, and must also have cleared the written round of UPSC ESE 2024, appeared for the ESE 2024 interview, and consented to sharing their score information on UPSC's website, without having been recommended for final selection. No minimum post-qualification experience is required for any of the four posts (NIL). All age relaxations are as per applicable Government of India guidelines. There is no relaxation in qualification criteria for internal candidates.

rows.essential_educational_qualification: Minimum 60% marks in B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent (courses approved by UGC & AICTE wherever applicable; ODL degrees not permissible)
Minimum 60% marks in B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent (courses approved by UGC & AICTE wherever applicable; ODL degrees not permissible)

rows.maximum_age_as_on_01_august_2026: As per Government of India guidelines
Relaxation up to 1 year, subject to CMD approval

content_sections.heading: MECL Executive Trainee Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed as Executive Trainees during a one-year training period at an initial Basic Pay of ₹40,000 per month in the E-1 (IDA) pay scale of ₹40,000–₹1,40,000, along with applicable Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA). In addition to Basic Pay and IDA, the posts carry other benefits including: House Rent Allowance (HRA) and cafeteria-approach allowances Provident Fund (PF) and National Pension System (NPS) Performance Related Pay Group Medical Insurance MECL-Employee Defined Contributory Superannuation Scheme Group Personal Accident Insurance and Term Insurance Two/four-wheeler vehicle loan and house building advance, as per company guidelines

content_sections.heading: MECL Executive Trainee Application Fee
content_sections.text: An application registration fee of ₹500 is applicable for General/OBC/EWS candidates. The fee is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates. Payment must be made online through Net-Banking or a QR code hosted on the MECL website under the Careers section. The fee, once paid, is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination or selection.

content_sections.heading: MECL Executive Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: The MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 selection process is based entirely on the UPSC ESE 2024 score, with no separate written examination or personal interview conducted by MECL: In case of a tie in total UPSC ESE 2024 score, seniority in age (as per Matriculation certificate) will be considered first, followed by a higher aggregate percentage in the essential engineering degree.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: The following self-attested, scanned documents must be uploaded with the online application:

rows.document_name: Valid caste/community certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in Central Government format
UPSC ESE 2024 scorecard with roll number and stream clearly visible
ID proof (Aadhaar Card mandatory, plus PAN/Driving License etc.)
Proof of payment of application fee (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for the MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 by following these steps: Visit the official MECL website: www.mecl.co.in and go to the "Career" section. Register on the MECL Online Recruitment Portal with all mandatory details. Log in and click on "Apply for a Post" to fill the online application form. Enter personal details, educational qualification, UPSC ESE 2024 score, and category/community details accurately. Upload the required scanned documents in the specified format and file size. Pay the application fee (₹500 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable) online. Submit the application before the closing date of 14 August 2026. Take a printout of the system-generated application form for future reference. Applications received through any mode other than the MECL Online Recruitment Portal will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to apply.

faq.question: Q1. What is MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited (MECL) to fill 13 Executive Trainee posts in Electrical and Mechanical disciplines, based on candidates' scores in the UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2024.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 vacancies are available: 1 for Executive Trainee (Electrical) and 12 for Executive Trainee (Mechanical) across Procurement & Contract, Store & Disposal, and Drilling divisions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 August 2026. Online registration commenced on 1 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MECL Executive Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum of 60% marks in B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Electronics Engineering (for the Electrical post) or Mechanical Engineering (for the Mechanical posts), from a UGC/AICTE-recognized institute. No post-qualification experience is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years (UR) as on 1 August 2026, with age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, and additional relaxation for PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates as per Government of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500 for General/OBC/EWS candidates. It is not applicable for SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Departmental candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the MECL Recruitment Portal at www.mecl.co.in under the Career section, between 1 August 2026 and 14 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MECL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based solely on the candidate's UPSC ESE 2024 score (out of 1200), with shortlisting followed by a Document Verification round. No separate written test or personal interview is conducted by MECL.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MECL Executive Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive an initial Basic Pay of ₹40,000 per month in the E-1 (IDA) pay scale of ₹40,000–₹1,40,000, along with IDA, HRA, PF, NPS, Performance Related Pay, medical insurance, and other benefits.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond for MECL Executive Trainee posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must serve a minimum of 36 months and execute a service bond of ₹1.8 lakh, with a monthly retention deduction of ₹5,000 from salary that is refunded on completion of the bond period.
